title: One-step execution equation
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a finite program, $t$ a nonnegative integer, and $c$ a configuration consisting of a program counter and an integer-indexed memory of $W$-bit words. Executing $P$ from $c$ for $t+1$ steps returns the halted verdict with $c$'s memory if the next step halts; if that step continues at a configuration $c_1$, it returns the result of executing $P$ from $c_1$ for $t$ steps.
